products.name: PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum (Cinnamoroll edition)
products.notes: Controversial for allegedly containing very little PDRN, but many call it a holy-grail item. Slightly runny texture with some weight that gives hydration, glow, light nourishment and a slight tackiness that makes foundation stick well. She's seen it used in makeup shops a lot and thinks the cute Cinnamoroll packaging helped it hit #1.

body.summary: The creator reviews the Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum (Cinnamoroll edition), describing its slightly runny but weighty texture that leaves a glow and light tackiness that helps foundation adhere.
